Name: SV Player Stats
Author: BeetleJuice20
Description:
[center][size=5][b]📊 SV Player Stats[/b][/size]
[i]Track your progress with an in-game stats menu and optional HUD overlay![/i][/center]

Tired of digging through menus to see your progress? This mod adds a clean [b]Player Stats Menu[/b] and an [b]optional on-screen HUD overlay[/b] that updates live as you play.

[size=4][b]✨   Features[/b][/size][list]
  [b]Player Stats Menu[/b][list]
[*]Open with [b]F5[/b] (configurable).
[*]Shows your key stats like steps taken, days played, items shipped, monsters defeated, fish caught, money earned, and more.
[*]Organized, scrollable, and styled to match Stardew’s menus.
[/list]  [b]
HUD Overlay[/b][list]
[*]Displays your most important stats right on screen, next to small Stardew-style icons.
[*]Toggle on/off instantly with [b]~[/b] (tilde key, configurable).
[*]Customizable position (X/Y %) in config.
[*]Matches vanilla UI with a proper background box
[/list][size=4][b]
Controls[/b][/size]  [b]
F5[/b] Open/Close Player Stats Menu  [b]
~ (Tilde)[/b] Toggle HUD Overlay[/list]
(Both keys can be changed in the config menu.)

  [b]Requirements[/b]
  [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
  Configure everything in-game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional but recommended)

[b]My Mods[/b]

[/list]
